response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT Name, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms / (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM r) AS ratio_to_average FROM r
